CALIBRATION_CAUTION: Caution: these functions can impair RepOne’s accuracy, do not use unless directed by support.

CALIBRATION_STEP_1.TITLE: Step 1
CALIBRATION_STEP_1.TEXT_1: Pull the tether out at least one foot, and make sure no objects (including your hand) are near the nozzle
CALIBRATION_STEP_1.BUTTON_LABEL: I’m holding the tether, start calibration

CALIBRATION_STEP_2.TITLE: Step 2
CALIBRATION_STEP_2.TEXT_1: Pull the tether to a sharp angle and move it in circle around the perimeter of the nozzle.
CALIBRATION_STEP_2.TEXT_2: Continue to circle the nozzle until you
CALIBRATION_STEP_2.TEXT_2_HIGHLIGHT: no longer see the numbers on the device’s screen changing.
CALIBRATION_STEP_2.BUTTON_LABEL: The numbers are no longer changing
